info.title: SVC API
info.description: Versioned API for role-filtered client, agreement, project, task, time, expense, invoice and received-payment operations. Payment recording is bookkeeping only and never initiates a charge. Expense receipts use authenticated multipart uploads.

post.description: Workspace managers only. Requires both AGENT_API_WRITES_ENABLED and AGENT_API_CLIENT_WRITES_ENABLED. Versioned writes also require the corresponding read scope. Enabling automatic delivery requires a delay and a valid billing email or client portal recipient. Existing records require their current opaque expected_version; agreement creation uses the parent client version. Activation and termination require confirm: true.

put.description: Workspace managers only. Mark an agreement as billed in Square by its recurring series key (the six-digit prefix of the series' NNNNNN-R-NNNN invoice numbers). SVC still generates and issues the agreement's invoices, but never emails, charges or offers a payment link for them. Requires the agreement's current expected_version and confirm: true. A series already marking another agreement is refused with 409. Nothing is sent to Square.

get.description: Workspace managers only. Whether the client's automatic payment reminder cadence is on, since when, its steps, and the client version companies.payment_reminders.set requires.

put.description: Workspace managers only. Turn the client's automatic payment reminder cadence on or off: 3 days before an invoice's due date, on it, then 7 and 14 days after, between 09:00 and 17:00 in the workspace's time zone. It is off until turned on. Turning it on never sends a step that fell due before; turning it off stops every step not yet sent. An invoice Square collects is reminded about only with Square's own payment page, and not on the cadence while Square charges a card on file or sends its own reminders for it. Requires the client's current expected_version; the change is recorded in the client history.

delete.description: Workspace managers only. Clear a client's confirmed Square customer. The mapping is kept as history. Requires the client's current version from companies.square_customer.get and confirm: true.

One client per Square customer: a customer already mapped to another client is refused with 409. Requires the client's current version from companies.square_customer.get. Square ids are checked for shape only; nothing is sent to Square.

delete.description: Disconnects the calling application from the calling person's account, as a finance system does when the person turns its connection off. Every credential the person holds for the calling OAuth client is revoked in one transaction - pending authorization codes and refresh tokens before access tokens - so nothing issued to that client can act or mint a replacement, including a refresh already in flight. Other applications' connections, and other people's connections to the same application, are unaffected. A personal API token disconnects only itself. Any REST credential may call it; an MCP connection uses connections.revoke.

401.description: The token is missing, expired or revoked, or is not a REST credential.

x-agent-write-safety.note: Revokes only the calling application's credentials for the calling person; repeating it is harmless.

delete.description: Disconnects the calling connection: token is the id of the access token making the request. Its refresh tokens are revoked before the access token itself, in one transaction, so the connection cannot mint a replacement; the token stops working on the next request. Any other token id, including another of the same person's connections, is a 404 and revokes nothing. For two minutes afterwards, a refresh of this connection that was already in flight is revoked as it is issued, so it cannot keep the connection; the person's other connections, including to the same client, are unaffected. Every connection a person holds is revoked by an operator with svc:auth:revoke-connections.

x-agent-write-safety.note: Revokes only the calling connection; repeating it is harmless.

get.description: Received payments with what each is worth net of refunds, how much of that its active finance reconciliation allocations cover, and every allocation, active first; newest received first. Succeeded payments unless status is given; status=any returns every status, so a full refund (refunded) and a partial one (still succeeded) are both seen. 50 a page unless per_page is (at most 100), numbered by page. For incremental sync, name updated_since, watermark or cursor instead of page: payments then come newest change first (updated_at, then id) inside a snapshot watermark that the first page of a pass fixes (now, or an earlier time given) and every page returns in meta; follow meta.next_cursor until it is null, then start the next pass with updated_since set to that watermark (inclusive; starting a few seconds earlier is harmless). Timestamps only find candidates: compare version, which also moves when one of the payment's allocations changes. Payments are never deleted. Workspace owners/admins; with the finance token, any workspace member. Internal ids, payment notes and processor payment identifiers are never returned. The Sanctum finance token issued by svc:auth:issue-token is accepted too, its finance.read and finance.reconcile abilities standing for these scopes.

The Sanctum finance token issued by svc:auth:issue-token is accepted too, its finance.read and finance.reconcile abilities standing for these scopes.

put.description: Create or update the finance reconciliation allocation the path names: the share of a received payment, in integer minor units of its currency, that one transaction in an external finance system covers. One transaction may cover several payments and one payment several transactions, but a payment's active allocations never exceed what it is worth net of refunds, and only a succeeded payment can be reconciled. Answers 201 when it created the allocation and 200 when it updated it. is_active is required (the finance token may omit it, keeping the allocation's state), so a delayed retry never reactivates an allocation withdrawn since: send the state wanted now. Any change advances the payment's version. Idempotent by its path, so it takes no Idempotency-Key. Nothing moves money. Workspace owners/admins only. The Sanctum finance token issued by svc:auth:issue-token is accepted too, its finance.read and finance.reconcile abilities standing for these scopes.

post.description: Make an audited in-place correction to an unpaid issued invoice that has not been emailed to the client: its due date and/or line wording, and money only on operator-authored lines. Omitted lines are kept as they are; supplied lines must name every existing line. The document revision advances and any automatic client delivery is held for explicit release. Requires explicit user confirmation and a reason kept in the client history. Paid, partially paid, sent and void invoices are refused; void and reissue those instead.

get.description: Workspace managers only. Read complete before/after evidence for one correction, scoped to its workspace and invoice.

post.description: Create an ad-hoc draft invoice for a client from explicit manual lines and/or explicit approved time, with the fields of the invoice screen's form: invoice_number (default: the workspace's next number; a number already used is refused), issue_date (default: the day it is issued), a service period (either end may be given alone), is_visible_to_client (default false; issuing makes it visible), currency, due and scheduled issue dates and notes. Nothing is issued or sent.

200.description: Draft discarded and linked time released

post.description: Manager only. period_start is a started retainer cadence cycle; service dates reconcile the preceding work cycle. Calls the existing cadence engine, the same path invoices.preview_period rolls back. A non-void invoice for this period is refused, while identical idempotent retries return the created draft. Nothing generates cadence period drafts automatically: a started period without one is waiting for this call, and billing_audit.stale_and_missing lists those periods. Requires confirmation and the agreement version.

200.description: Authorized invoice with browser payment URL

patch.description: Replace the explicit time selection and manual lines on a draft invoice.

post.description: Issue a draft invoice as a workspace owner or admin, using its current version and confirm: true. Issuing never emails the client itself; automatic invoice email, when the client has it, is scheduled after its delay. An optional payment records money already received elsewhere in the same transaction and receipt (payments:record and AGENT_API_PAYMENT_WRITES_ENABLED); it never initiates a charge, and the scheduled delivery is cancelled. Requires AGENT_API_WRITES_ENABLED and AGENT_API_INVOICE_WRITES_ENABLED.

parameters.description: Send `read` to receive the issued invoice exactly as invoices.get presents it, when the token also holds billing:read; without that scope the response keeps the write shape. Any other value is refused before anything is written, and the view is not part of the request an Idempotency-Key binds.

200.description: Invoice issued, and paid when a payment was supplied

401.description: Not signed in, or the token is missing, expired or revoked.

403.description: The caller is not a workspace owner or admin, or the token lacks billing:deliver; with a payment, also without payments:record or while AGENT_API_PAYMENT_WRITES_ENABLED is off. Each is checked again on a replay.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key header is missing, view is not read or is sent as a field, confirm is not true, or a field is invalid (`errors` names it). Also when the invoice cannot be issued (void, or a draft that fails its checks), when a payment is sent for an invoice that is no longer a draft, or when the payment is in another currency, exceeds the balance or predates the issue date. Without a payment, an invoice already issued, partially paid or paid is returned as it is, not refused.

get.description: Five-minute signed URL. Download still requires current API or browser authentication and current invoice visibility.

Workspace managers only. Runs the checks and cadence engine of invoices.generate_period for one started retainer cycle inside a transaction that is always rolled back, and returns the draft it would write and any other invoice of the client the same generation would create, rewrite or remove. Writes nothing and takes no idempotency key. Refuses what generation refuses, with the same status, including 409 for a period that already has a non-void invoice. agreement_version is the expected_version a following invoices.generate_period call must present. Nothing generates cadence period drafts automatically; billing_audit.stale_and_missing lists started periods with no non-void invoice.

200.description: The draft generation would write; nothing is written

get.description: Workspace managers only. Whether a payment reminder may be sent for the invoice now, to whom and with which pay link, why not when it may not, where the client's automatic cadence stands for it, and the latest 50 reminders, newest first, with who or what sent each and its result.

post.description: Workspace managers only. Email the client a payment reminder for an issued or partially paid invoice with a balance, now, from SVC's usual invoice sender to the client's billing address and portal users. An invoice Square collects carries Square's own payment page and is refused with 422 when there is none usable (not linked, not mirrored, not open in Square, or paid partly outside Square); SVC never sends its own payment link for it. Any other invoice links to the client portal when the client could open it there, and carries the invoice PDF. Another reminder leaving for the same invoice is a 409. Requires the invoice's current expected_version and confirm: true. The reminder is registered with this request's receipt and sent once it commits; the response is the logged reminder with its result (sent, failed or cancelled). Repeating the same idempotency key returns the same reminder and sends nothing more.

Email an issued invoice to explicit recipients, only with confirm: true and the current expected_version, with the invoice screen's compose fields: an optional subject (default: the invoice's own), an optional covering message, and bcc_self to blind-copy the signed-in user's own address - no other blind copy can be named. The delivery is registered with this request's receipt and sent once it commits; repeating the same idempotency key sends nothing more.

get.description: Rank possible counterparts for this invoice with explainable scores capped at 100. Suggest at 70 or more, never auto-link. Candidates require a confirmed customer or an explicitly marked agreement series. Canceled invoices are excluded unless requested; other currencies and invoices linked elsewhere are excluded. Reports ambiguous top scores and a truncated pool. Reads svc's mirror of the connected Square account, refreshed every 15 minutes and by square.sync; it never reaches Square, and meta.last_synced_at says how fresh it is. Workspace managers only, and only in the workspace Square is connected to; unavailable while Square is not configured. Amounts are in minor units.

post.description: Workspace managers only. Link an SVC invoice to its Square invoice, as confirmed by a person: never automatically. Each side has at most one active link: a Square invoice already linked anywhere is refused with 409, and so is an invoice that is already linked unless replace: true re-points it (the replaced link is kept as history). Requires the invoice's current expected_version and confirm: true. When currency is given it must equal the invoice's. While an invoice is linked, or its agreement is billed in Square, SVC never emails it to the client, charges it or offers a payment link for it; issuing it and recording payments stay open. Square ids are checked for shape only; nothing is sent to Square.

delete.description: Workspace managers only. Unlink an invoice from its Square invoice. The link is kept as history and either side may be linked again. Requires the invoice's current expected_version and confirm: true.

patch.description: Change the due date, scheduled issue date and/or notes of any draft invoice, generated or ad hoc, using its current version. Lines, linked time and the hours statement are unchanged, and a generated draft keeps the change when it is regenerated. A due date may not precede the draft's issue date. The scheduled issue date is a plan that billing_audit.stale_and_missing reads; nothing issues or sends on it. Issued invoices are corrected with invoices.correct instead.

get.description: Always returns workspace_id; project, time, and invoice sections are omitted unless the token has their corresponding read scope. With billing:read, a workspace manager also receives deferred_backlog: the agreements with deferred work outstanding and what termination would charge for it.

patch.description: Owner/admin correction of a received payment's descriptive fields: method, reference, notes and received_on, at least one of which must be given. Requires confirm: true, the version from payments.list (hence payments:read as well as payments:record) and a reason, which is kept in the client history. Omitted fields are unchanged; an explicit null reference or note clears it. A stale version is refused with 409 and a correction that changes nothing records nothing. Amount, currency, status, refunds, the invoice and processor fields cannot be changed. Never initiates a charge or a refund. Requires both outer workflow and payment write flags.

get.description: List received payments for an explicit invoice_id or company_id (at least one required). Invoice visibility applies; private processor and reconciliation data is excluded.

post.description: Owner/admin bookkeeping for money already received, with the same fields as the invoice screen's payment form. Never initiates a charge. Explicit invoice, minor-unit amount, currency and method required. received_on is the day the money arrived and defaults to today on the workspace calendar; reference, notes and the finance system's transaction id are optional; status is succeeded (the default) or pending for money not yet cleared, which payments.set_status later settles. Read invoices.get with billing:read for the current invoice expected_version; confirm: true is required. A succeeded payment over the balance is refused. Requires both outer workflow and payment write flags.

Owner/admin record of money already returned to the client outside SVC, against a succeeded payment that was recorded by hand. amount is what was returned now, in minor units, at most what is left unrefunded; refunding the whole amount makes the payment refunded, otherwise it stays succeeded with its refunded_amount raised. The invoice's paid amount, balance and status are recomputed, so a paid invoice reopens by the amount; correct or void the invoice separately if the client no longer owes it. Requires confirm: true, the version from payments.list and a reason, which is kept in the client history. A stale version is refused with 409. Refused with 422: a payment recorded by a processor (Stripe, Square), which reports its own refunds; a pending, failed, canceled, disputed or fully refunded payment; more than is left; or a refund that would exceed the payment's active finance reconciliation allocations. SVC never sends money. Requires both outer workflow and payment write flags.

Owner/admin change of the status of a payment that was recorded by hand: succeeded when money recorded as pending cleared; failed when it bounced or was reversed; canceled when it was recorded in error and is withdrawn. Allowed from pending to any of the three, and from succeeded with nothing refunded to failed or canceled. failed, canceled, refunded and disputed are final - money that arrives later is recorded as a new payment - and a partly refunded payment is refunded in full instead. Setting the status it already has changes nothing. The invoice's paid amount, balance and status are recomputed, so withdrawing a succeeded payment reopens the balance; a succeeded payment cannot exceed the invoice total and cannot succeed on a void invoice. Requires confirm: true, the version from payments.list and a reason, which is kept in the client history. A stale version is refused with 409. Refused with 422: a payment recorded by a processor (Stripe, Square), which reports its own status; a transition outside these; or leaving succeeded while the payment holds active finance reconciliation allocations. Never initiates a charge or a refund. Requires both outer workflow and payment write flags.

Reads svc's mirror of the connected Square account, refreshed every 15 minutes and by square.sync; it never reaches Square, and meta.last_synced_at says how fresh it is. Refresh svc's read-only mirror of the connected Square account now, rather than waiting for the scheduled sync every 15 minutes: locations, customers, every invoice with its series_key, status, amounts, due date, Square reminder schedule and public_url, and payment ids for paid invoices. Reads Square only; nothing is created, changed or paid in Square, and no svc invoice changes. Returns the run, which ends completed or failed with a reason; a few manual syncs are allowed per ten minutes. Repeating the same idempotency key returns the same run.

Requires AGENT_API_TIME_ENTRY_WRITES_ENABLED.

hours_applied.description: Deferred work a retainer pool of this month absorbed, booked on the ledger's capacity date.

hours_billed.description: Deferred work that left the shelf this month at an hourly price instead: on termination, as flat-hourly work, or by a buy-down.

InvoicePreviewLine.description: A line exactly as invoices.get returns it, without an id: nothing was written, so there is none.

step.description: The cadence step of an automatic reminder; null for one a person sent.

pay_link.description: square: Square's own payment page for an invoice Square collects. svc_portal: the invoice in the client portal, a sign-in page with no token. none: no link; the invoice PDF was attached.

amount_due.description: The balance the reminder stated, in minor units.

status.description: sent and failed are the mail provider's answer; cancelled was stopped before anything left because the invoice or its Square link changed. A reminder left sending was accepted by the provider without its result being saved.

triggered_by_name.description: The person who sent it or on whose behalf an agent did; null for the cadence.

next_attempt_at.description: When the cadence retries a failed step; null when it will not.

hold.description: What stops the cadence for this invoice whatever the date; null when its steps are sent as they fall due.

subject.description: Omitted or null uses the invoice's default subject.

message.description: A covering note shown above the invoice. Omitted or null uses the template's own words.

bcc_self.description: Send a blind copy to the signed-in user's own address. No other blind copy can be named.

link.description: The active link to a Square invoice, or null.

agreement_series_key.description: The Square series of the agreement this invoice was generated under, when that agreement is billed in Square.

square_collects.description: True when the invoice is linked or its agreement is billed in Square. SVC then never emails it to the client, charges it or offers a payment link; issuing and recording payments stay open.

collection_refusal.description: Why SVC will not collect this invoice, as the collection paths report it; null when SVC collects.

currency.description: The Square invoice's currency. When given it must equal the SVC invoice's; the link records the SVC invoice's currency.

score.description: Suggested links only: the score the person saw.

reasons.description: Suggested links only: the reasons the person saw.

replace.description: Required to re-point an invoice that is already linked; the replaced link is kept as history.

scheduled_issue_date.description: The day you plan to issue this draft; null clears it. Nothing issues or sends on it: billing_audit.stale_and_missing flags the draft once the day has passed.

PaymentReminderRefusal.description: Why a payment reminder is not sent: a stable code and a sentence for the operator.

PortalInvitation.description: A portal invitation to an address nobody signs in with yet. Never carries the acceptance link.

repository.description: Canonical host/owner/name this project is worked in, or null when unmapped. Absent entirely for a portal client, who is not shown internal repository names.
Repository remote or canonical host/owner/repository; stored in canonical form.
Canonical host/owner/name this project is worked in, or null when unmapped. Absent entirely for a portal client, who is not shown internal repository names.
Repository remote or canonical host/owner/repository; stored in canonical form.

reference.description: Null unless the reader is a workspace owner/admin.

notes.description: The operator's private note. Null unless the reader is a workspace owner/admin.

external_finance_transaction_uuid.description: The finance system's transaction the payment was recorded against. Null unless the reader is a workspace owner/admin.

manual.description: Recorded by hand rather than by a payment processor. Only a manual payment can be moved by payments.set_status or payments.refund.

notes.description: The operator's private note; null or blank clears it.

received_on.description: The day the money arrived (YYYY-MM-DD), not in the future and at most two years back on the workspace's calendar. Omitted means today on that calendar.

status.description: succeeded for money that has arrived; pending for money not yet cleared, such as an uncleared cheque. Move it later with payments.set_status.

external_finance_transaction_uuid.description: The finance system's transaction this payment was received as.

reason.description: Why, kept in the client history.

amount.description: What was returned to the client now, in minor units; at most what is left unrefunded.

reason.description: Why, kept in the client history.

status.description: succeeded: money recorded as pending cleared. failed: it bounced or was reversed. canceled: it was recorded in error and is withdrawn.

series_key.description: The six-digit prefix every invoice of a recurring NNNNNN-R-NNNN series shares; null for a one-off.

status.description: Square's invoice status, e.g. DRAFT, UNPAID, SCHEDULED, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, REFUNDED, CANCELED, FAILED, PAYMENT_PENDING.

public_url.description: Square's hosted view-and-pay page; only ever HTTPS on a Square host.

last_synced_at.description: When the last completed sync finished; null before the first.

SquareCustomerId.description: A Square customer id, held as an opaque string. SVC checks its shape only.

series_key.description: The six-digit prefix shared by every invoice of a recurring NNNNNN-R-NNNN series; null for a one-off invoice.

series_occurrence.description: The NNNN suffix of a recurring series invoice number; null for a one-off invoice.

subscription_id.description: Square's subscription id, set only on invoices its Subscriptions API generated; a dashboard recurring series has none and is grouped by series_key.

public_url.description: Square's hosted page for the invoice; null unless it is HTTPS on a Square host.

card_on_file.description: Square will charge a stored card; the card itself is never returned.

reminders_truncated.description: True when Square sent more reminders than are listed.

payment_requests_truncated.description: True when Square sent more payment requests than are listed.

SquareInvoiceId.description: A Square invoice id, held as an opaque string. SVC checks its shape only; it never resolves it against Square.

series_key.description: Derived from the number at link time; null for a one-off.

score.description: The suggestion score the person confirmed; null for a manual link.

reasons.description: The suggestion reasons the person confirmed; null for a manual link.

linked_by.description: Who confirmed the link, by name.

SquareInvoiceNumber.description: The Square invoice number as Square shows it. A recurring series occurrence is NNNNNN-R-NNNN, whose six-digit prefix is the series key.

SquareMirrorInvoice.description: A Square invoice as svc's mirror last saw it.

series_key.description: The six-digit prefix every invoice of a recurring NNNNNN-R-NNNN series shares; null for a one-off.

status.description: Square's invoice status, e.g. DRAFT, UNPAID, SCHEDULED, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, REFUNDED, CANCELED, FAILED, PAYMENT_PENDING.

public_url.description: Square's hosted view-and-pay page; only ever HTTPS on a Square host.

autopay.description: A payment request charges a card on file automatically.

reminders.description: Square's own reminder schedule for the invoice.

payment_ids.description: Square payment ids from the invoice's order; null until a sync has read them.

last_synced_at.description: When the last completed sync finished; null before the first.

SquareMoney.description: An amount in minor units of an ISO 4217 currency.

line_items_truncated.description: True when Square sent more line items than are listed.

tenders_truncated.description: True when Square sent more tenders than are listed.

processing_fee_truncated.description: True when Square sent more processing fees than are listed.

refund_ids_truncated.description: True when Square sent more refund ids than are listed.

SquareSeries.description: A recurring Square series, summarised from its mirrored invoices.

missing_occurrences.description: Occurrence numbers between the first and last that no mirrored invoice carries.

open_amount.description: Owed on unpaid and partially paid members; scheduled members are not issued yet.

SquareSeriesDetail.description: A recurring Square series with every mirrored member, by occurrence.

missing_occurrences.description: Occurrence numbers between the first and last that no mirrored invoice carries.

open_amount.description: Owed on unpaid and partially paid members; scheduled members are not issued yet.

SquareSeriesKey.description: A Square recurring series: the six-digit prefix of its invoices' NNNNNN-R-NNNN numbers.

last_synced_at.description: When the last completed sync finished; null before the first.
When the last completed sync finished; null before the first.

SquareSyncRequest.description: No fields: a sync always refreshes the whole mirror.

SquareSyncRun.description: One pass of the Square mirror sync.

square_version.description: The Square-Version every request of the run sent.

high_water_mark.description: The newest Square updated_at the run saw.

truncated.description: True when a listing was longer than one run reads; the mirror is then incomplete.

last_synced_at.description: When the last completed sync finished; null before the first.

stale_draft_count.description: Drafts whose due date or scheduled issue date is before as_of, the workspace's today.

agreement_count.description: Active or terminated agreements with deferred work outstanding, or with a withheld backlog.

truncated.description: True when more agreements have a backlog than are listed, or the scan reached its bound.

agreements.description: Withheld backlogs first, then the largest. No trend.

is_visible_to_client.description: Hidden from clients when omitted. Callers choose visibility explicitly when publishing a task.

invoice_id.description: Public id of the tenant-owned invoice allocating this time; null when unallocated.

allocation_state.description: No allocation, a draft-invoice reservation, or an allocation to a non-draft invoice. Legacy approved status does not imply unallocated.

author_id.description: Public author id; null when the author is not a member of this workspace.

client_visible_description.description: The text a client reads on the invoice. `description` stays the internal note for anyone on the worker's side of the entry; a portal client receives this text there too and never the internal note.

TimeEntryBatchResponse.description: The logged rows exactly as time_entries.list presents them, rates and subcontractor terms included for workspace owners and admins, when the request asks for view=read and the token also holds time:read; the write shape otherwise. The MCP tool asks for the view while time_entries.list is enabled.

is_visible_to_client.description: When omitted, defaults to true if client_visible_description contains text. Send false to keep the entry hidden while staging client text.

client_visible_description.description: Client-facing text. When supplied without is_visible_to_client, the entry defaults to client-visible.

billing_rate_amount.description: Explicit rate in minor units; requires the time:approve OAuth scope and a user who can approve project time.

approve.description: Approve the logged entries in the same transaction. Requires the time:approve OAuth scope, a user who can approve time on every project, and the agent write cutover; if approval is refused nothing is logged.

TimeLogRequest.description: Log entries within the workspace calendar time sheet window: the current month and the preceding eleven months.

worked_on.description: Workspace calendar date within the time sheet’s twelve-month window, through the end of the current month.

task_id.description: Omit to preserve the task; null clears it. A task must belong to this entry’s project.
